subject.title: Homepage facelift: hero CTAs, aurora glow, refined cards

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this homepage visual direction and above-the-fold CTA treatment after the release-owned changelog entry is removed?
rationale: The patch is a visual/product direction change rather than a mechanical bug fix, and automated review cannot decide the homepage brand direction for maintainers.

options.title: Adopt after changelog removal
options.body: Keep the visual facelift and CTAs, but remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit before merge.

options.title: Narrow to CTA only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that adds the hero CTAs without the broader aurora, texture, spacing, and card restyle.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or defer the facelift if maintainers do not want this brand treatment on the homepage now.

recommendation.title: Adopt after changelog removal
recommendation.body: Keep the visual facelift and CTAs, but remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the current homepage and SectionHeader baseline that this PR restyles.
